title: fix(logging): preserve appended records after concurrent truncation
body:
## What Problem This Solves

A log file can be truncated between metadata sampling and reading. When that shorter read ends with a newline, the log-tail reader advances its cursor to the earlier file size rather than the bytes it actually consumed. If the file then grows back to that size, subsequent reads silently omit the newly appended records because no file-shrink reset is triggered.

## Why This Change Was Made

Advance the existing cursor to the byte immediately after the last newline actually read. The same expression already handles an unterminated record. Keep the existing reader, sampled size metadata, bounds, filtering, redaction, rolling-file selection and reset policy.

This fixes the existing file-tail owner used by log consumers; it is independent of the optional CLI severity presentation change in #146986. It does not add another read path or change that PR's feature contract.

## User Impact

Log followers can read new complete records after a concurrent truncation and regrowth instead of silently skipping them. UTF-8 byte offsets, nonzero cursors and fully filtered windows keep the correct consumed position. Incomplete records remain pending until a later newline arrives. The reader remains read-only.

## Evidence

Prepared candidate: `0a8ba924eaa30191c21fb3847bcf4cc0f7ccbb4d`; pinned main: `912ae8d96e5964dfdcdf419b79613fb941cdf0a8`. This is a signed, conflict-free mechanical merge refresh. Parent 1 remains Alix-007's original head `333e5d5f8486b651b8fb9583b567b79bd2090f9c`; parent 2 is the pinned main. The resulting tree exactly matches `git merge-tree --write-tree <main> <original-head>`. No source or test edits were made during landing preparation.

### Refreshed-head validation

- macOS, Node 26.7.0, lockfile-matching existing dependencies: **77/77 tests passed**, no skips, using `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/log-tail.test.ts src/cli/logs-cli.test.ts src/cli/logs-cli.port.test.ts` (26 logging tests and 51 CLI tests across two native shards).
- Targeted type-aware oxlint, two-file oxfmt, test-temp checks, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh independent P0-P2 autoreview: scoped-clean, zero actionable findings. Test audit retained the three real-filesystem regressions as distinct coverage of initial, continuation, and filtered cursor behavior.
- Worker bundling emitted unresolved-import warnings for unrelated workspace dependencies; all requested tests loaded and passed. Repository-wide typechecks and guards were not run locally; exact refreshed-head hosted CI remains required before merge.
- Main-relative scope remains exactly `src/logging/log-tail.ts` (+3/-2) and `src/logging/log-tail.test.ts` (+50/-0), preserving newer main behavior.

### Original real filesystem before/after readback

Original contributor head: `333e5d5f8486b651b8fb9583b567b79bd2090f9c`; original base: `e9c1cb7e71b7e0fb17a0e0f53491349b8faeb669`. The original investigation also verified the same stale-size cursor expression in main source `0e4b4d1fa38c6d78d8cd4f8520d0335457fd07c7`; its newer redaction-context work is not replaced or changed by this one-hunk repair.

Linux, Node 26.1.0, frozen-lockfile-matching physically independent dependencies, isolated HOME/config/state. The driver loads the actual `readConfiguredLogTail` and logger through the repository TS loader. It writes a real UTF-8 log, schedules one real truncate immediately before the production file open, reads through the normal reader, appends a new record, and reads again using the returned cursor.

The only interposition controls when the real truncation occurs by calling through `fs.open`; no metadata value, read buffer, byte count, redactor, logger or tail result is fabricated. Appending restores exactly the previously sampled size, so a later shrink check cannot hide the bug.

```sh
node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs ../evidence/B07-02/proof.mjs "$PWD" baseline
node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs ../evidence/B07-02/proof.mjs "$PWD" candidate
```

Actual receipts from the same scenarios:

| Scenario | Sampled size / available end offset | Before: first cursor / next lines | After: first cursor / next lines |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Initial read, `kept ✅` retained | 24 / 9 bytes | `24`, `[]` | `9`, `["arrived-record"]` |
| Continuation after `seen` | 29 / 14 bytes | `29`, `[]` | `14`, `["arrived-record"]` |
| All first-window lines filtered out | 24 / 9 bytes | `24`, `[]` | `9`, `["arrived-record"]` |
| Unterminated-line control | `kept\npending` then append `-complete\n` | cursor `5`, `["pending-complete"]` | cursor `5`, `["pending-complete"]` |

All regrowth follow-ups reported `reset: false`; the repaired reads returned only the new record, without repeating the retained line. Both runs confirmed unchanged file contents after readback, unchanged isolated configuration, stable source, and successful scratch removal. Candidate stderr was empty.

The original proof-covered production SHA-256 `0be1da8c770b5a2917a6e95bff3ca972c3381fdde8718f16ca3de59eb0dd66e3` matches the file committed at `333e5d5f8486b651b8fb9583b567b79bd2090f9c` after the normal formatting hook. The driver ran before that commit against these unchanged production bytes, not a rebuilt distribution.

### Original repository validation

- Same new regression cases on unchanged production: **23 existing/control tests passed; 3 truncation/regrowth assertions failed**.
- Candidate command below: **77/77 passed**, no skips, in two native Vitest shards. Per file: log-tail 26, logs CLI 35, CLI port/read behavior 16. Existing short positional reads, unterminated lines, redaction, limits, reset and error handling remain covered.

```sh
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/log-tail.test.ts src/cli/logs-cli.test.ts src/cli/logs-cli.port.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=<receipt>
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/logging/log-tail.ts src/logging/log-tail.test.ts
```

- Targeted type-aware lint: **2 files, 263 rules, zero warnings/errors**.
- Changed-file formatting, normal formatting commit hook and staged `git diff --check` passed.
- One fresh independent P0–P2 autoreview: scoped-clean, no actionable findings. It checked consumed-byte semantics and the controls without rerunning builds/tests.

Scope: production +3/-2 including comments; tests +50/-0. No new configuration, protocol fields, persistent formats, dependencies, filtering rules, or redaction policy. The original validation did not claim a full build/typecheck, live remote Gateway delivery, Windows runtime or all-green hosted CI. The original CLI sibling tests emitted an existing Vite dynamic-import analysis warning in the unchanged worker bootstrap; it did not fail the tests and was not suppressed.
